judge.rationale: The candidate implements the core Ajv validation in `ToolRegistry` and adds `CHANGELOG.md` and `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`, but leaves the task visibly unfinished. Specifically, it fails to update `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`, and omits the required one-line doc comment on `execute` and the `WeakMap` cache for dynamic tool schemas. It also misses several required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` (such as the unknown tool throw test and putting the orchestrator test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`). Finally, the candidate leaves `.lore/dod.md` and `registry.acceptance.test.ts` in the tree, the latter of which has documented lint failures (`re-lint/prefer-early-return` and `re-lint/max-member-chain`) that break the required `npm run eslint` check.
